decisions.why: own-site crawl (piedro-uk.co.uk), 145 products, all shoe models (e.g. 'Model: 2266 – Stability – Velcro', 'Model: 2602-Reverse Last-Blue'); the site's own sub-categories within this division are 'Children' (129), 'AFO' (13) and 'AFO - Ankle Foot Orthosis Footwear' (3) — all three are shoe ranges shaped/sized for AFO-wearing children, not orthosis devices themselves, so all 145 are footwear.
own-site crawl, 65 products, division name and every product name is a bare model number under the site's own 'Adult Orthopaedic Footwear' category — unambiguous.

own-site crawl, 31 products, the site's own sub-categories are 'Rehabilitation Footwear' (16), 'Stability Footwear' (10), 'Reverse Last Footwear' (3) and 'AFO Footwear' (2) — all footwear, distinguished from the AFO devices in 'Soft Goods & Accessories' below by the site's own '...Footwear' naming.

own-site crawl, 9 products under the site's own 'Adult Piedro PRO' shoe range (model names are given names, e.g. 'Lieke', 'Stein', 'Bram' — Piedro's own naming convention for this footwear line, confirmed against piedro-uk.co.uk's own product listing).

own-site crawl, only 2 products and neither is footwear: 'AFO – Ankle Foot Orthosis' (the device itself) and 'AFO, KAFO & SMO Interface Socks' (an accessory worn under exactly those orthoses) — filed under orthotics:afo, not orthotics:footwear, on the strength of the products' own names.
